steps.content: In the fierce confrontation, Jasmine dodges a barrage of heavy projectiles with several side flips and returns to Sibilla's side.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Oh my! Sibilla, what are you still doing here? You should be running! This isn't your show to play. It's dangerous to stay here. Hehh—!
As she speaks, she casually raises her blades and deflects several <color=#fb9259>glowing</color> bullets aimed at them.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Enough, Jasmine. There are too many of them, and they're coordinating well. You'll get overwhelmed at this rate. I can see you slowing down already.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: They're regrouping. Now's our chance to get out! Those weapons... something's not right about them. They—
From a corner hidden from their view, the iron-masked man raises his hand towards the two and clenches his fist.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Ugh!
Without warning, several iron pillars wrench free from the ground, and crash into Jasmine's right shoulder.
Sibilla's earrings and the flying iron bullets plunge into the sand, swallowed by the unseen depths. Even her blood turns sluggish, a molten weight dragging through her veins.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...Magnetism?
Jasmine's twin blades are also pinned to the earth, yet she clings to them, her grip unyielding even as it leaves her exposed.
In the distance, the red blade scar etched across the masked man's neck ignites. Even from afar, Sibilla sees it unfurl: a crimson flower blooming at his throat.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: That weapon doesn't belong to you. Where did you steal it from?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Heh, who knows why it picked me? Why don't you ask it yourself? It's being so loud right now... screaming...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...for me to slit your throat!
She rises to charge back into battle, but a figure pounces on her without warning.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Watch out!
Sibilla throws herself over Jasmine as they tumble aside, narrowly avoiding the barrage that crashes nearby. The shockwave follows, flinging them even farther as debris rains down.

Gunfire cracks through the air again. Another ferocious barrage of bullets seems to be aiming directly at where they have landed, their trajectories indiscernible. Before Sibilla can react, Jasmine drags a sleeve across her bloodied lips, her blades flashing awake once more.

But in the next breath, she whirls around in astonishment. The chaotic gunfire isn't ahead of them at all. It's raking the enemy lines from behind, choking the enemy advance into sudden, eerie silence.
The masked man ceases his attack—not because of his enemy, but at the pulse of a special transmission.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Hello...

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Stop? Why?

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: ...I see. Please provide cover for our retreat.
The flower on his neck rapidly withers, followed by a magnetic pulse that twists Sibilla's stomach.

The reinforcements hidden beneath the sand seem to see through the enemy's intentions, hastily pursuing with a downpour of gunfire. Their bullets explode in midair, forming a wall of mist, yet not a single shot finds its mark.
[Transition]
When the wall of mist dissipates and silence falls, the steel ghosts have vanished without a trace.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...They got away... I haven't even...
Her voice thins to a whisper as she crumples into Sibilla's arms. The crimson gashes across her body rapidly fade, and her skin grows cold...

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Jasmine, Jasmine! Wake up! Don't die here!
She's suffering from severe Mania backlash and needs treatment. Let us handle this.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: You are...?
From beneath the sand dunes, several cloaked figures shed their camouflage and quickly slide down the sandy slopes toward Sibilla and Jasmine, offering them a bow.
Wasting no time, they quickly administer first aid and protective measures to the unconscious woman before turning to address Sibilla in the common tongue thick with an unfamiliar accent.

steps.speaker: The Joint Caravan
steps.content: We're a trade caravan of the Farland Alliance, here for the Expo. Our camp is nearby, fully stocked with supplies and medicine. It's well-hidden and very safe.

steps.speaker: The Joint Caravan
steps.content: We're not from DisCity, and we mean her no harm. In fact... you've fought bravely against those DisCity mad dogs, and that alone makes you our allies.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...Please, help her.
